test_cases.name: Caveats present for generic/off-topic sources
test_cases.description: When a COVERED item's source is generic or off-topic for the goal (e.g., general product-discovery for an AI-specific question), the item MUST have a caveat tag. Validates the distinction: subset-of-scope gets caveat; orthogonal-to-scope should be OPEN.
test_cases.goal: Identify AI-PM-specific discovery practices and frameworks I should master
test_cases.test_logic: For COVERED items from notes/discovery/ (general PM), check that they have caveat tags. For COVERED items from notes/ai-* (AI-specific), check they do NOT have false-positive caveats.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: 100% — All generic-source items have caveats; all on-topic items do not

test_cases.name: Uncited claims are not in covered_items
test_cases.description: If a COVERED item has no source citation (or source is None/null), it should NOT be in the covered_items dict at all — it should have been demoted to open_items during validation.
test_cases.goal: Identify AI-PM-specific discovery practices and frameworks I should master
test_cases.test_logic: Iterate over covered_items dict: every item must have (source, caveat) tuple where source is not None and not empty string
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: 100% — No covered item has source=None or source=''

test_cases.name: No duplicate items in covered + open
test_cases.description: No item should appear in both covered_items and open_items, and no item should appear twice within open_items.
test_cases.goal: Identify AI-PM-specific discovery practices and frameworks I should master
test_cases.test_logic: Check: len(set(covered_items.keys()) & set(open_items)) == 0 and len(set(open_items)) == len(open_items)
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: 100% — Zero overlap, zero duplicates in open_items

test_cases.name: Coverage arithmetic is consistent
test_cases.description: Every round, coverage_count + open_count must equal total_count. This was the '28/25' impossible-count bug from Session 15.
test_cases.goal: Identify AI-PM-specific discovery practices and frameworks I should master

test_cases.name: Cited sources are valid file paths
test_cases.description: Every source cited in covered_items must be a valid, existing file path (resolves to a real note file in the knowledge base).
test_cases.goal: Identify AI-PM-specific discovery practices and frameworks I should master
test_cases.test_logic: For each (item, (source, caveat)) in covered_items: source must point to a file that exists in notes/
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: 100% — All sources are valid file paths (not invented, not partial paths)

metadata.eval_philosophy: Validate against ACTUAL output structure, not pre-specified items. Tests check that research_goal() produces well-formed output with correct properties: all items accounted for, all caveats justified, all sources valid.
metadata.test_strategy_change: Session 17: Changed from 'LLM-as-judge of pre-specified items' to 'structural validation of generated output'. The feature generates its own item list; tests now validate that list has correct properties rather than matching a pre-written list.

acceptance_bar.structural: 100% — structural properties of output must always hold
